description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between model size and average performance metrics, specifically Precision, Recall, and F1-score. The x-axis is labeled “Model Size (log scale)” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 70m to 7.0B, with tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. 

A red line, marked with triangular symbols, represents Precision; starting at approximately 72% at 70m, it decreases to approximately 68% at 7.0B. A blue line, marked with triangular symbols, represents Recall, beginning at approximately 8% at 70m and increasing to approximately 33% at 7.0B. Finally, a purple line, also marked with triangular symbols, represents F1-score, starting at approximately 16% at 70m and increasing to approximately 51% at 7.0B.
